summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Eni Njoku, focusing on his academic training in botany. It states he studied botany at the University of Manchester, graduated with first class honors in 1947, earned an M.A. the following year, and received a doctorate from the University of London in 1954.
one_line: Biographical note on Eni Njoku's botany education at the University of Manchester and University of London, 1947–1954.
key_facts: Eni Njoku studied botany at the University of Manchester in England.
Eni Njoku graduated with a first class honors degree in 1947.
Eni Njoku obtained his M.A. degree the year after graduating, in 1948.
In 1954, Eni Njoku obtained his doctorate from the University of London.
